headline: Seatrium Sinks Over 7% on Workforce Reductions in Singapore
summary: Seatrium shares fell more than 7% after the marine and engineering group announced it will cut about 220 jobs in Singapore, marking its first workforce restructuring since its 2023 merger.
why: Corporate restructuring and workforce reductions provide insights into operational efficiency and cost management in heavy industries.

impacts.name: Seatrium
impacts.why: Announcements of job cuts and restructuring directly impact investor sentiment toward the company's operational outlook.
